title: Storybook Component Spec
description: One file per component: the design<->code contract and the story kinds the component owes. Portable, with two declared repo-profile extension points — see x-repo-profile on tier and generatedArtifactRefs.

specVersion.description: Literal. Bump only alongside a validator change.

componentId.description: kebab-case. Must equal the spec filename stem — a filesystem rule JSON Schema cannot express, enforced by the validator.

tier.description: REPO PROFILE. Deliberately an open string here: allowed values and their minimum required kinds are owned by the repo's tier policy (see storybook-tier-policy.schema.json), not by this spec.

requiredStoryKinds.description: Kinds this component must prove. Must be a superset of the tier policy's minimumRequiredKinds for this tier.

ownedStoryRefs.description: Stories this spec owns. storyId must be unique across the array.

repoPath.description: Repo-relative path. Not absolute, not ./ or ../ prefixed, no URI scheme.

generatedArtifactRefs.description: REPO PROFILE. The concept is portable — 'generated proof surfaces this spec points at' — but the key names are one repo's set. A consumer redefines the key set in its profile and keeps the nullableRepoPath value rule.

downstreamHooks.description: The design<->code link. codeEntrypoint + figmaComponentRef are the durable mapping pair; there is no Code Connect layer.
